authority_boundary.RETAIN: requires all three actually revealed assay values within frozen thresholds
authority_boundary.VETO: requires an actually revealed assay value beyond its frozen failure threshold

forbidden: real-dollar laboratory savings without a source-backed assay cost schedule
claim_boundary.history: Held-out simulation evidence that adaptive routing helped, but sequence information did not earn a material routing increment over simple conditional assay-history statistics.
claim_boundary.sequence: Held-out simulation evidence that sequence-conditioned routing reduced assay reveals relative to the best fixed order while all final VETO/RETAIN decisions remained measurement-backed.

interpretation: Adaptive routing did not clear the frozen savings bar over the strongest fixed-order baseline. On this three-assay substrate, there is no measurement-allocation mechanism worth promoting.
stop_rule: If NO_MEASUREMENT_ROUTING_SIGNAL, close the three-assay routing hypothesis on this substrate. Do not rescue it by changing thresholds, source cohort, fold assignment, savings bars, or cost weights after observing the result.
